theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Examples.div_complement_classical
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (a b : ℚ) (h : b ≠ 0) : div_complement a b = Outcome.value (a / b)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Examples.halts_decidable_returns_value
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p : Program) (i : Input) (h : decidable_halting p i) : ∃ (b : Bool), halts_complement p i = Outcome.value b

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Examples.halts_total
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p : Program) (i : Input) : ∃ (result : Outcome Bool), halts_complement p i = result

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Examples.halts_undecidable_returns_limit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (p : Program) (i : Input) (h : ¬ decidable_halting p i) : halts_complement p i = Outcome.limit LimitState.haltingUndecidable

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.classical_addition_preserves
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (a b : ℕ), lift (a + b) = Outcome.value (a + b)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.classical_equality_preserves
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} : ∀ (x y : α), x = y → lift x = lift y

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.classical_lifts
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (φ : Prop) (D : Regime) : φ → Provable_Complement φ D

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.classical_undefined_returns_limit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α β γ : Type} : ∀ (op : α → β → Outcome γ) (a : α) (b : β), (∀ (result : γ), op a b ≠ Outcome.value result) → ∃ (ℓ : LimitState), op a b = Outcome.limit ℓ

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.lift_preserves
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} (x y : α) : x = y → lift x = lift y

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.limit_preserves_consistency
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (ℓ : LimitState) (P : Prop), ¬ ((Outcome.limit ℓ : Outcome Prop) = Outcome.value P ∧ (Outcome.limit ℓ : Outcome Prop) = Outcome.value (¬P))

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.limits_coexist
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (ℓ₁ ℓ₂ : LimitState), ∃ (system : Type), (Outcome.limit ℓ₁ : Outcome system) ≠ Outcome.value False ∧ (Outcome.limit ℓ₂ : Outcome system) ≠ Outcome.value False

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.system_not_trivial_at_limit
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ {α : Type} (ℓ : LimitState), ∃ (P : Prop), ¬ Provable_From_Limit ℓ P where Provable_From_Limit (ℓ : LimitState) (P : Prop) : Prop

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.totalization_requires_sacrifice
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: : ∀ (System : Type), (∀ (op : System → Outcome System), ∃ (result : System), op result = Outcome.value result) → (¬ Expressive System) ∨ (¬ NonTrivial System) ∨ (¬ Consistent System)

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Universe00.Laws.value_limit_disjoint
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: {α : Type} : ∀ (x : α) (ℓ : LimitState), Outcome.value x ≠ Outcome.limit ℓ
